request.spec:
For every period whose to-date is on or before the sheet's today, each pool member's line shows
the member's cut as it stood at the end of that period (the pool, its members, the pot and the
holds as they were then, with that day as the sheet's today), empty when there was none.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
For every period whose to-date is on or before the sheet's today, each pool member's line shows
the member's cut as it stood at the end of that period (the pool, its members, the pot and the
holds as they were then, with that day as the sheet's today), empty when there was none.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Each pool member's line now shows a cut for every period that has ended (to-date on or before the sheet's today), with the testid `pool-cut-<period>`. Each figure is worked out as the sheet stood at the end of that period, and is empty when the member had no cut then. All 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

**What "as it stood then" covers.** Nothing recorded when pools, crews or their members were added, so I added that. A new migration, `V96__pool_made_on.sql`, adds a `made_on` column to `pool`, `pool_member`, `crew` and `crew_member`. Each new row is stamped with the sheet's today when it's added. Rows that existed before this change have no stamp and are treated as always having been there. When working out a past date, only these things count if they were made on or before that date:
- pools and crews, and their members
- holds
- retirements (the last one recorded by that date)
- the pot (looked up as it was set by that date)

**Where it lives.**
- **Server:** `PoolRepository.list` calculates the pools as of the end of each finished period and attaches the results to each member as a `history` list. That list is held in the new `PeriodCut` record, and `PoolMember` gains a `history` field.
- **Front end:** `pools.ts` and `pools.slot.tsx` show one value per finished period after the current cut.

Two other side effects:
- **As-of view:** the pools in the existing as-of view now also leave out pools, crews, holds and retirements added after the chosen date. Before, they always included them.
- **Load cost:** the pools list now recalculates the pools once for every finished period each time it loads, so a sheet with many past periods will make more database queries on each load.
